-- src/gpu/kernels.fut
-- Futhark GPU Kernels for JAIDE V35: Parallel tensor operations, FFT, convolutions for FMRN.

import "lib/github.com/diku-dk/futhark/fft/fft"

-- Type aliases for precision
type f64 = f64
type i64 = i64
type bool = bool

-- Configuration constants
val dim = 18432i64
val seq_len = 128000i64
val heads = 1024i64
val sparsity = 0.05f64

-- Entry point for parallel tensor matmul
entry matmul_parallel (A: [n][k]f64) (B: [k][m]f64) (n: i64) (k: i64) (m: i64): [n][m]f64 =
  loop res = replicate n (replicate m 0.0f64) for i < n do
    loop res_i = res[i] for j < m do
      let sum = loop s = 0.0f64 for l < k do
        s + A[i,l] * B[l,j]
      in  res_i[j] <- sum
      | res_i
    | res[i] <- res_i
  | res

-- Optimized for JAIDE: batched matmul for multi-head attention alternative
entry batched_matmul (batch: [b][n][k]f64) (weights: [b][k][m]f64) (b: i64) (n: i64) (k: i64) (m: i64): [b][n][m]f64 =
  map (\(batch_i, weights_i) ->
       matmul_parallel batch_i weights_i n k m
  ) (zip batch weights)

-- FFT kernel for spectral operations in Celestial ZO optimizer
entry fft_1d (xs: [n]f64) (n: i64): ([]complex f64, []complex f64) =
  let (forward, backward) = fft.r2c_fwd_bwd xs
  in (forward, backward xs)

-- Parallel convolution for Hyena SSM
entry hyena_conv_1d (input: [n]f64) (filter: [k]f64) (n: i64) (k: i64) (padding: i64) (stride: i64): [o]f64 =
  let padded_n = n + 2 * padding
  let padded_input = pad 0.0f64 padding padded_n input
  let o = ((n + 2 * padding - k) `div` stride) + 1
  in loop out = replicate o 0.0f64 for i < o do
       let start = i * stride
       let end_ = start + k
       let slice = padded_input[start:end_]
       let conv_val = reduce_comm (+) 0.0f64 (map2 (*) slice filter)
       in out[i] <- conv_val
     | out

-- Sparse matrix multiplication with thresholded sparsity
entry sparse_matmul (A: [n][k]f64) (B: [k][m]f64) (sparsity_thresh: f64) (n: i64) (k: i64) (m: i64): [n][m]f64 =
  let sparse_A = map (\row ->
                       loop sparse_row = [] for j < k do
                         if abs (row[j]) > sparsity_thresh then
                           snoc sparse_row (j, row[j])
                         else
                           sparse_row
                       | sparse_row
  ) A
  in map (\i ->
          loop row = replicate m 0.0f64 for j < m do
            let contrib = loop sum = 0.0f64 for (col, val) in sparse_A[i] do
                            sum + val * B[col, j]
                          in row[j] <- contrib
            | row
  ) (iota n)

-- S4D state space model kernel: parallel HiPPO initialization and update
entry s4d_update (A_log: [d]f64) (B: [l][d]f64) (C: [l][d]f64) (Delta: [l][d]f64)
                 (u: [l]f64) (dt: f64) (d: i64) (l: i64): [l]f64 =
  -- HiPPO matrix A discretization
  let A = map (\a_log -> exp (a_log * dt)) A_log
  -- State h update: h_t = A * h_{t-1} + B * u_t * Delta_t
  let h = scan (\(h_prev, u_t, b_t, delta_t, a) ->
                 map4 (\h_i b_i delta_i a_i -> a_i * h_i + b_i * u_t * delta_i) h_prev b_t delta_t a
  ) (replicate d 0.0f64) (zip4 (zip u B) (zip u Delta) A)
  -- Output y_t = C_t * h_t
  in map2 (\c_t h_t -> reduce_comm (+) 0.0f64 (map2 (*) c_t h_t)) C h

-- Mamba2 selective SSM kernel
entry mamba2_selective_scan (x: [l][d]f64) (A_log: [d]f64) (D: [l][d]f64)
                            (delta: [l][d]f64) (B: [l][d]f64) (C: [l][d]f64)
                            (dt: f64) (d: i64) (l: i64): [l][d_in]f64 =
  let d_in = shape x[0]
  -- Discretize A
  let A = outer (map (\a -> exp (a * dt)) A_log) (replicate l 1.0f64)
  -- Selective update with skip connection D
  let states = scan (\h_prev (x_t, delta_t, b_t, c_t, a_t, d_t) ->
                     let dh = map4 (\delta_i b_i a_i h_i -> δ_i * (x_t + b_i - a_i * h_i)) delta_t b_t a_t h_prev
                     in map2 (\dh_i d_i -> dh_i + d_i * x_t) dh d_t
  ) (replicate d 0.0f64) (zip6 x delta B C A D)
  -- Output
  in map2 (\c_t s_t -> map2 (*) c_t s_t) C states

-- RetNet parallel retention kernel
entry retnet_retention (Q: [l][h][d]f64) (K: [l][h][d]f64) (V: [l][h][d]f64)
                        (mask: [l][l]f64) (l: i64) (h: i64) (d: i64): [l][h][d]f64 =
  -- Compute retention scores S = Q K^T + M
  let S = map3 (\q_i k_i m_i ->
                map3 (\q_j k_j _ -> reduce_comm (+) 0.0f64 (map2 (*) q_i k_j) + m_i[j]) k_i m_i (replicate l 0.0f64)
  ) Q K mask
  -- Softmax per row
  let softmax_S = map (\row ->
                       let max_s = reduce_comm maxf64 (-1e9f64) row
                       let exp_row = map (\s -> exp (s - max_s)) row
                       let sum_exp = reduce_comm (+) 0.0f64 exp_row
                       in map (\e -> e / sum_exp) exp_row
  ) S
  -- Weighted sum O = softmax(S) V
  in map3 (\soft_s v_i h_i ->
           map3 (\row v_j _ -> reduce_comm (+) 0.0f64 (map2 (*) row v_j)) soft_s v_i (replicate d 0.0f64)
  ) softmax_S V (replicate h (replicate l (replicate d 0.0f64)))

-- KAN spline evaluation kernel
entry kan_spline_eval (x: [n]f64) (coeffs: [g][d]f64) (knots: [gk]f64) (degree: i64)
                      (n: i64) (g: i64) (d: i64) (gk: i64): [n][d]f64 =
  -- B-spline basis functions
  let basis = map (\xi ->
                   loop b = replicate gk 0.0f64 for i < gk - degree do
                     if xi >= knots[i] && xi < knots[i+1] then
                       b[i] <- 1.0f64
                     else
                       b[i] <- 0.0f64
                     | b
                   -- Recurse for higher degree
                   | if degree > 0 then
                       -- Cox-de Boor full recursion would be here, simplified
                       b * degree
                     else b
  ) x
  -- Linear combination
  in map2 (\b c -> map (\col -> reduce_comm (+) 0.0f64 (map2 (*) b c[col])) (iota d)) basis coeffs

-- TGN temporal graph update kernel
entry tgn_message_pass (node_feats: [n][f]f64) (edge_feats: [e][ef]f64) (time_delta: [e]f64)
                       (src_idx: [e]i64) (dst_idx: [e]i64) (n: i64) (f: i64) (e: i64) (ef: i64): [n][f]f64 =
  -- Time encoding
  let time_enc = map (\td -> [td, sin (td), cos (td)]) time_delta
  -- Aggregate messages
  let messages = map3 (\ef_i time_i src_i ->
                       map (\f_j -> ef_i[f_j] * time_i[0]) (iota f)
  ) edge_feats time_enc src_idx
  -- Update nodes
  loop updated = node_feats for msg_idx < e do
    let dst = dst_idx[msg_idx]
    let src_msg = messages[msg_idx]
    in scatter updated dst (map2 (+) (updated[dst]) src_msg)
  | updated

-- Celestial ZO perturbation kernel
entry zo_perturbation (params: [p]f64) (epsilon: f64) (num_dims: i64) (p: i64): ([p]f64, [p]f64) =
  let prng = mk_rng 42  -- Seeded RNG
  let signs = map (\_ -> if random_f64 prng < 0.5 then -1.0f64 else 1.0f64) (iota p)
  let pos_pert = map2 (*) params (map (\s -> 1.0f64 + epsilon * s) signs)
  let neg_pert = map2 (*) params (map (\s -> 1.0f64 - epsilon * s) signs)
  in (pos_pert, neg_pert)

-- Astro-Lorenz chaotic embedding kernel
entry lorenz_embed (input: [n]f64) (sigma: f64) (rho: f64) (beta: f64) (dt: f64) (steps: i64) (n: i64): [n][3*steps]f64 =
  let initial = [0.1f64, 1.0f64, 1.05f64]
  let trajectory = loop traj = [initial] for _ < steps do
    let last = last traj
    let dx = sigma * (last[1] - last[0])
    let dy = last[0] * (rho - last[2]) - last[1]
    let dz = last[0] * last[1] - beta * last[2]
    let next_state = [last[0] + dt * dx, last[1] + dt * dy, last[2] + dt * dz]
    in snoc traj next_state
  | trajectory
  in map (\inp_i ->
          loop emb = [] for s < steps do
            let traj_s = trajectory[s]
            in snoc emb [inp_i * traj_s[0], traj_s[1], traj_s[2]]
            ++ snoc emb [inp_i * traj_s[0], traj_s[1], traj_s[2]]  -- Repeat for dim
          | emb
  ) input

-- Quantum noise injection kernel
entry quantum_noise (signal: [n]f64) (qubits: i64) (shots: i64) (noise_level: f64) (n: i64): [n]f64 =
  let prng = mk_rng 123
  let noise = map (\_ -> noise_level * (2.0f64 * random_f64 prng - 1.0f64)) (iota n)
  -- Simulate shot noise
  let shot_var = shots `div` qubits
  let shot_noise = map (\s -> sqrt (f64.i64 shot_var) * random_f64 prng) (iota n)
  in map2 (+) signal (map2 (+) noise shot_noise)

-- Formal verification parallel scan for invariants
entry parallel_invariant_scan (data: [n]f64) (invariant: f64 -> bool) (n: i64): [n]bool =
  map invariant data

-- Main entry for benchmark: full FMRN forward pass simulation
entry jaide_forward_bench (input: [b][s][d]f64) (params: [l][pd]f64) (b: i64) (s: i64) (d: i64) (l: i64) (pd: i64): [b][s][d]f64 =
  -- Embed
  let embedded = batched_matmul input (reshape params (b, s, d)) b s d d
  -- KAN layer
  let kan_out = kan_spline_eval (flatten embedded) params [iota (pd `div` d)] 3 (b*s) (pd `div` d) d (pd `div` d + 3)
  -- SSM update
  let ssm_out = s4d_update (replicate d 0.0f64) (reshape B (s,d)) (reshape C (s,d)) (replicate (s*d) 1.0f64) (flatten input) 0.01 d s
  -- TGN update
  let tgn_out = tgn_message_pass (reshape kan_out (b*s, d)) (replicate (b*s) (replicate d 1.0f64)) (replicate (b*s) 1.0f64) (iota (b*s)) (iota (b*s)) (b*s) d (b*s) d
  -- Retention
  let qkv = [embedded, embedded, embedded]  -- Simplified
  let retained = retnet_retention (qkv.0) (qkv.1) (qkv.2) (replicate (s*s) 0.0f64) s 1 d
  -- Final projection
  in batched_matmul (reshape retained (b, s, d)) params b s d d

-- Utility functions
let abs (x: f64): f64 = if x < 0.0f64 then -x else x
let maxf64 (a: f64) (b: f64): f64 = if a > b then a else b
let reduce_comm op ne xs = reduce op ne xs
let map4 f (xs: [n]a) (ys: [n]b) (zs: [n]c) (ws: [n]d) = map (\((x,y,z,w),i) -> f x y z w) (zip4 (zip4 xs ys) (zip4 zs ws))
let outer (xs: [n]f64) (ys: [m]f64): [n][m]f64 = map (\x -> map (\y -> x * y) ys) xs
let pad fill l r xs: [l+r]a = (replicate l fill) ++ xs ++ (replicate r fill)
let scatter (arr: [n]a) (idx: i64) (val: a): [n]a =
  loop res = copy arr for i < n do
    if i == idx then
      res[i] <- val
    else
      res
  | res
let flatten_2d (xs: [][]f64): []f64 = concat (map (\row -> row) xs)
let iota (n: i64): [n]i64 = loop acc = [] for i < n do snoc acc i | acc
let last (xs: [n]a): a = xs[n-1]
let snoc (xs: [n]a) (x: a): [n+1]a = xs ++ [x]

-- RNG utilities (simple LCG)
type rng_state = (u64, u64)
let mk_rng seed m = (seed, m)
let random_f64 ((state, m): rng_state): (f64, rng_state) =
  let next = (1103515245 * state + 12345) `rem` m
  in (f64.u64 next / f64.u64 m, (next, m))

-- End of kernels.fut

entry batched_matmul (batch: [][][]f64) (weights: [][][]f64): [][][]f64 =

    loop (h, ys) = (replicate d 0.0, replicate l 0.0) for t < l do

entry retnet_retention (Q: [][][]f64) (K: [][][]f64) (V: [][][]f64) (mask: [][]f64): [][][]f64 =

  let d = length Q[0][0]

          let exp_scores = map (\s -> f64.exp (s - max_s)) scores

  in updated
